A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neona]], which was located in the [[Freeworlds Territory]] of<ref name="LOE" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. The [[Species/Legends|species]] developed an advanced culture and constructed an extensive network of structures on Neona's surface.<ref name="LOE" /> Around [[19,997 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]'' places the [[Temperature/Legends|warming]] period on [[Neona]] to around 20,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which equates to around [[19,997 BBY]] per the calendar system in ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Neona underwent a sustained [[Temperature/Legends|warming]] period: polar [[Water/Legends|ice caps]] melted, raising the level of Neona's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] until all the planet's landmasses were covered except for a frozen continent at each pole. The flooding of their [[City/Legends|cities]] led to the extinction of the species.<ref name="LOE" />

[[3 ABY/Legends|Twenty-thousand]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, the ruins of their civilization still dotted Neona's ocean bed. By this time, Neona had become a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] world under the control of [[Hanson Mining Consolidated]]. While under Hanson Mining's administration, teams of [[Archaeology/Legends|archeologists]] and [[Sentientologist|xenoanthrolopogists]] occasionally [[Archaeology/Legends|explored]] these ruins, including when the [[Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy|Mrlsst Academy]] dispatched a team of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] to examine the ruins in a systematic study. They established a small [[Mrlsst Academy research station|research station]] underwater at the edge of a large ruin in Neona's southern hemisphere.<ref name="LOE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species was first mentioned in ''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]'', a [[1997]] [[West End Games]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Tapani">''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]''</ref>
